_comment: Extracted by hand (2026-11-26) from Regions Unexplored (UHQ-GAMES-MODS/RegionsUnexplored branch 1.21, src/shared/21.1) and Biomes O' Plenty (Glitchfiend/BiomesOPlenty branch 1.21.1): their block and item ids with English names, and per biome its vegetation step (features from its own namespace) and grass/foliage colours.
